decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent spotlight line with a dedicated page, it likely sits close enough to aspiration levels to justify another year of learning under the firm's available slack.
Because it extends the firm's modular system offer and is prominently presented, management would see it as supporting core sales and partnerships even if early standalone results are still forming.
Its fit with the firm's established low-voltage system logic and its own product-page presence suggest performance is not clearly below aspiration, so resources are better left in place for now.

With only limited website prominence and after recent pruning of similar close-in launches, this line is more likely judged below aspiration and its resources are better reallocated to stronger core products and new development.
